fcm_listener_unavailable.title: FCM listener unavailable
fcm_listener_unavailable.description: The FCM listener for {entry_title} has been unavailable for an extended period. Normal call-history polling is active automatically, so incoming-call detection continues with polling latency. Check outbound access to mtalk.google.com:5228, the local Firebase configuration, and the Home Assistant log. The issue closes automatically after FCM reconnects.

fcm_state_recovered.title: FCM state was recovered
fcm_state_recovered.description: The private local FCM state for {entry_title} was unreadable, invalid, or belonged to a different Firebase application and has been regenerated safely. The integration uses call-history polling until the new listener connects. If the damaged state no longer contained a valid owned device ID, an older virtual registration could not be identified for automatic cleanup. If this happens repeatedly, check Home Assistant storage health. The issue clears after the next clean integration start.

fcm_unregister_failed.title: FCM registration cleanup pending
fcm_unregister_failed.description: The owned virtual FCM registration for {entry_title} could not be removed from Ufanet after FCM was disabled. Normal call-history polling remains active. The integration will retry cleanup automatically on the next setup. Check Ufanet connectivity and the Home Assistant log. This issue closes after successful cleanup.

last_call_image_unavailable.title: Last call image unavailable
last_call_image_unavailable.description: Last-call JPEG generation for {entry_title} is unavailable. Check that ffmpeg is installed and executable in the Home Assistant runtime, then inspect the integration diagnostics for the privacy-safe reason code and exception type. Existing call detection, archive playback and door control continue to work. The issue closes automatically after a successful image extraction.

user.title: Connect to Ufanet SmartHome
user.description: Enter the contract login and password used by the Ufanet SmartHome app.

error.unknown: Unexpected response from the service. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Ufanet account is already configured.

init.title: Ufanet Intercom options
init.description: Changes are applied after the integration reloads automatically. YAML values in custom:ufanet-intercom-card override only that card.

data_description.skud_scan_interval_seconds: How often the available intercom/SKUD list is refreshed.
data_description.call_scan_interval_seconds: call-history polling interval. In FCM mode it is used while the listener is unavailable; a healthy listener reduces polling to a 300-second safety interval.
data_description.call_update_mode: Polling requires no extra setup. Experimental FCM uses a locally extracted Firebase config for faster call detection.
data_description.call_media_refresh_seconds: How long preview/archive media URLs are cached internally for call processing. They are not published in entity state or call events.
data_description.call_lead_seconds: Start archive playback this many seconds before a call.
data_description.archive_default_duration_seconds: Used by HA archive entities and the card unless YAML sets duration.
data_description.archive_default_step_seconds: Used by HA archive entities and the card unless YAML sets step.
data_description.export_auto_cleanup: When disabled, post-export cleanup is skipped; manual cleanup remains available.
data_description.call_autosave_enabled: Automatically export a new call to Home Assistant Media. The pre-call part uses the Archive lead before call option.
data_description.call_autosave_after_seconds: How many seconds after the call timestamp to include in the automatic MP4.

fcm.title: Experimental FCM setup
fcm.description: Extract Firebase values locally with tools/research/fcm_probe_py/extract_firebase_config.py, copy the resulting JSON under the Home Assistant config directory, and enter its path. APK contents and Firebase values are not bundled with this integration.

error.fcm_config_not_found: The Firebase config file was not found.
error.invalid_fcm_config: The Firebase config is invalid or is outside the Home Assistant config directory.
